high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference, as indicated by the logo in the top right corner. The slide is titled "Artificial intelligence research is a grand quest" and discusses the goals and implications of AI research. Slide Content: The slide outlines the objectives of AI researchers, stating that they aim to understand intelligence well enough to create beings of greater intelligence than current humans. It mentions that reaching this milestone will enrich economies and challenge societal institutions.
